responsibility: This header defines the lang_hooks data structures that connect a GCC front end to the language-independent compiler core. It lays out the nested hook groups for declarations, types, tree dumping, inlining, LTO, gimplification, exception handling, diagnostics, builtins, OpenMP/OpenACC behavior, and other frontend-specific services, and declares helper entry points such as add_builtin_function and the global lang_hooks instance that each language frontend provides.
same_name_distinction: Defines the lang_hooks data structures, nested hook groups, and exported frontend-facing declarations, whereas gcc/langhooks.cc supplies the default executable implementations for many of those language hooks.
